topic: How to schedule AI tasks to continue an SOP driven workflow

sources.title: Scheduled tasks in ChatGPT
sources.claim: ChatGPT tasks can run one time or on a recurring schedule; tasks created within a project cannot access uploaded or project stored files.

sources.title: Projects in ChatGPT
sources.claim: Projects organize related chats, files, and instructions for ongoing work.

sources.title: ChatGPT Work and Codex
sources.claim: Local computer work requires desktop access, and local only computer tasks cannot run from shared links.

scopeNote: Feature availability and permissions depend on plan, app, and configured connections. Verify current access and destination behavior before scheduling consequential actions.
